system.description:
At no action cost, on your turn, you can spend 1 superiority die to temporarily unleash your limits, with the drawback of sacrificing your defenses. Until the beginning of your next turn, you gain the following benefits. If you would use this maneuver again before completing a rest, increase the number of Superiority Die you spend to activate this feature by +1 for each time used beyond the first.

You cannot be reduced below 1 HP as a result of damage from an attack or Jutsu. (Conditional damage can still reduce you to 0 HP)

You add your superiority die to the first attack roll you make each turn.

The first attack targeting you each turn is made at advantage.
